gaps.sentence: Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
He ___ up the word in an online dictionary.
gaps.explanation: 'Look a word up' = check its meaning.

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
The scientists carried ___ a series of experiments.
gaps.explanation: carry out = perform, conduct (research, a plan, an order).

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).
